Bright handover basic rules for seating plans
New handlers should know what is expected

This page covers the seat plan work that keeps animal trips calm, safe, and on track. At the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, your choices affect the traveler, the pet, and the crew, so every note must be clear and every handoff must be tight. You are not just filling spaces. You are keeping people and animals separated when needed, keeping support within reach, and making sure the flight team can act fast without confusion.

Start by reading the booking details with care and checking the animal profile against the passenger record. If a crate, carrier, or comfort request is listed, place that information where the desk and cabin teams can see it right away. Use short, plain language in every message. If something is unclear, do not guess. Raise it at once and move the file to the right person before the traveler reaches the counter.

When you arrange seating, keep the animal's needs first and the rest of the cabin second. Make space for smooth boarding and for any necessary contact with the senior coordinator or the crew. If the traveler is anxious, stay steady and kind. A calm voice helps more than a fast answer. If a pet like Miso is part of the booking, keep the pet note visible through the full handover so nobody misses it.

Before you pass the case on, check the seat plan, the remarks, and any special handling notes one more time. Then send only the facts that matter. Clear desk work protects the journey and reduces last-minute trouble. Remember that safety comes first, and clean handovers keep the whole shift moving. Companion Animal Travel Desk
